quarterly_data.quarter: Siltronic press release: Supplier Day 2026: Siltronic relies on strong partnerships (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At Siltronic's Supplier Day 2026 (180 representatives from 100 suppliers), CFO Claudia Schmitt said that despite a historically prolonged downturn in the wafer industry Siltronic invested significantly in expanding its capacities, particularly at its Singapore site, and in further developing its product portfolio at its Freiberg site, alongside programmes focused on cost control, investment discipline and liquidity management: 'Market conditions are improving. At the same time, discipline remains essential. ... Long-term success requires economically viable conditions and an appropriate sharing of risk along the value chain.' Suppliers named as 2026 Supplier Award winners: FUJIMI INCORPORATED (innovation), Meister Abrasives AG (quality), Wacker Chemie AG (sustainability), WSVK GmbH & Co. KG (flexibility), Herbert Arnold GmbH & Co. KG (execution) and ePAK International, Inc. (value creation).
